questions.stem: Why does drinking alcohol lead to increased urine production?

options.text: Alcohol damages the kidneys so they cannot concentrate urine
Alcohol increases blood pressure, forcing more filtrate out
Alcohol suppresses ADH release, so less water is reabsorbed
Alcohol increases the amount of urea produced by the liver

questions.explanation: Alcohol inhibits the release of ADH from the pituitary gland. Without ADH, the collecting duct walls remain less permeable to water, so less water is reabsorbed and a larger volume of dilute urine is produced.
